description: This file contains utility functions and classes for logging events within the Superset application, including request payload collection, logger configuration, and different logger implementations (database and stdout).

classes.name: AbstractEventLogger
classes.description: Abstract base class for event loggers, providing common logging interface and context management.

classes.name: DBEventLogger
classes.description: Concrete implementation of AbstractEventLogger that logs events to the Superset database.

classes.name: StdOutEventLogger
classes.description: Concrete implementation of AbstractEventLogger that outputs logs to stdout for debugging.

methods.name: collect_request_payload
methods.description: Collects and returns request-related data for logging purposes.

methods.name: get_logger_from_status
methods.description: Returns appropriate logger method and level based on HTTP status code.

methods.name: get_event_logger_from_cfg_value
methods.description: Validates and returns an event logger instance based on configuration value.
